 MCM: Sam Claflin
 Kendra 
 November 16, 2026 
 5 
 I have a hard time taking English actor Sam Claflin seriously following his role in the  Hunger Games movies series, but I think I’d better try harder given how many frock flicks he’s appearing in these days! He’s playing Fred in the newly released Ebenezer: A Christmas Carol , so let’s clear our minds of this:
 Okay so his character is SUPPOSED to come off as a cheesy beefcake with hidden depth in The Hunger Games: Catching Fire (2013). But this is my mental image of him! 
 With all of this!
 Richard in  The Pillars of the Earth (2010)
 A cathedral is built during the tumultuous 12th century, while two different contenders vie for the throne. Apparently Richard is Earl of Shiring.
 I know nothing about armor. 
 But this seems VERY BASIC for an earl? 
 Logan Mountstuart (Young) in Any Human Heart (2010)
 Several actors (including Matthew Macfadyen and Jim Broadbent ) play a writer in 1920s Paris, ’50s New York, and ’80s London. Claflin plays the youngest version.
 Three actors, same role. 
 He’s pulling off that cap! 
 Duncan Edwards in United (2011)
 A TV film set “It is based on the true story of Manchester United’s [football club] “Busby Babes” and the aftermath of the 1958 Munich air disaster, with the film’s events taking place between August 1956 and May 1958″ per Wikipedia.
 Philip in Pirates of the Caribbean : On Stranger Tides (2011)
 The fourth installment of the allegedly-18th-century-set pirate series.
 This seems more on-brand to me! 
 Who needs shirts? 
 HE DOES (need a shirt that is). 
 Jack in White Heat (2012)
 A miniseries “about a group of seven London-based students from 1965 to the present day” per IMDB.
 Laaate ’60s or 1970s? 
 William in Snow White and the Huntsman (2012) & The Huntsman: Winter’s War (2016)
 Okay, technically fantasy films, but the costumes are ye oldey timey!
 #needsmorerivets 
 #thehorsetoo 
 Tom Buckley in Their Finest (2016)
 Brits make propaganda films during World War II.
 I barely recognize him here! 
 Love the nerdy! 
 Philip in My Cousin Rachel (2017)
 An adaptation of a gothic romance by Daphne du Maurier .
 Those are EXCELLENT collars . 
 Great layering. 
 Nice fall-front breeches! 
 Captain Stanhope in Journey’s End (2017)
 An adaptation of a World War I-set play.
 Hawkins in The Nightingale (2018)
 A woman bent on revenge chases a British officer through Tasmania in 1825.
 Alright I DEFINITELY didn’t recognize him here! 
 Mycroft Holmes in Enola Holmes (2020)
 A film about Sherlock Holmes’s (supposed) younger sister.
 EXCELLENT coat-age. 
 And slicked-over hair! 
 THOSE LAPELS THO. 
 Oswald Mosley in Peaky Blinders (2019-22)
 As the real-life 1920s-30s fascist politician in this TV series about a post-World War I British crime gang.
 I do love a good tux! 
 We’re pretty roundly anti-fascist around here, but I gotta say, they do (tend to) dress well. 
 Recall anyone? 
 Edmond Dantès in The Count of Monte Cristo (2024)
 A TV miniseries adaptation of the Dumas novel.
 Great collars on Claflin. 
 But after watching the French film from the same year , I couldn’t muster the enthusiasm for this. 
 Fred in Ebenezer (2026)
 A comedy horror take on the Charles Dickens classic novel, A Christmas Carol . Fred is Scrooge’s nephew.
 What’s your favorite Sam Claflin historical role?
